sources_reviewed.title: Waze live listing
sources_reviewed.supports: Current chapter name and 1001 Hilltop Drive address corroboration.

limitations: Footprint recheck compares against the same GIS ring used to originate the asset. Its near-perfect fit verifies serialization and transform, not surveyed wall-line truth.
Wall/eave height, roof pitches and intersections, window spacing, and secondary elevations are photo-based estimates; GIS Extrution has no dependable unit or vertical datum.
Interior room functions are represented by schematic partitions and furniture from gallery use references; no measured floor plan was found.
Gallery exterior photos date to 2017; current identity/address are supported by the GIS and live listing, while current exterior condition has not been independently photographed.
